_comment: Copy this to .local/pdf-template.json to customize PDF output. All values are optional — only include what you want to override. The style preset ('modern' or 'classic') is applied first, then these overrides are merged on top.

header._comment: Candidate name displayed at the top of the letter

contact._comment: Contact info line below the name

date._comment: Date line below the header block
date._comment_spacing_before: Vertical gap (inches) between contact line and date
date._comment_spacing_after: Vertical gap (inches) between date and letter body

body._comment_line_height: Height per line in inches. 0.22 = tighter, 0.28 = more airy
